why_slower: using card 1 as an expert cache displaced the 15.3 GiB pageable RAM expert set, so 161 GB of expert blobs were read from files over the run
each token's expert results traverse PCIe back through pinned host rows, so the second card adds transfer cost rather than bandwidth
the single-card resident-CPU-expert placement keeps experts in DRAM with zero file reads and zero cross-device traffic
two_card_experiment.conclusion: for this 68 GB IQ2_XS pack on a 2x24 GB box, VRAM-expert-caching on the second card loses to pageable-RAM residency on one card. Two cards only make sense with --serve --layer-split (each GPU owns layers), which generate mode does not support.
